annotations.title: Create a story draft from a public URL

description: Create a story draft from a media URL that is already publicly accessible; for a file the user has, call createUploadLink first. This creates a draft only. Ask the user to approve the destination and timing before scheduling. For publishing now, call publishStory after the user approves the content and destinations.

contentGroupId.description: Content group to create the story in.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Stories must be ≤60s.

mediaFit.description: How non-9:16 media is fitted into the 1080x1920 story frame: contain (letterbox with black bars, default), cover (crop to fill), or fill (stretch).

mediaUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the story media. Graph API and TikTok pull from this URL during publishing.

platforms.description: Target platforms. Can also be set later via publish/schedule.

name: createStory
